items.front: How many districts does Andhra Pradesh have as of 2026, and since when?
items.back: 28 districts, since 31 Dec 2025 (26 after 4 Apr 2022).
items.examPoint: AP has 28 districts (Markapuram & Polavaram from 31 Dec 2025)

items.front: The two districts formed on 31 Dec 2025 and their headquarters?
items.back: Polavaram (HQ Rampachodavaram, from Alluri Sitharama Raju) and Markapuram (HQ Markapuram, from Prakasam).
items.examPoint: AP 28 districts with effect from 31 Dec 2025 — new Polavaram (HQ Rampachodavaram) & Markapuram (HQ Markapuram)

items.front: Is Madanapalle a separate AP district?
items.back: No — it is the HQ of Annamayya district. The '29th district' proposal was NOT notified; AP has 28.
items.examPoint: Madanapalle is HQ of Annamayya district (NOT a separate district); AP has 28 not 29 districts

items.front: When did AP's 28 zilla parishads (one per district) come into effect?
items.back: 25 September 2026.
items.examPoint: 28 zilla parishads with effect from 25 Sep 2026 (one per district)

items.front: AP's CM, Deputy CM and ruling coalition (2026)?
items.back: CM N. Chandrababu Naidu (TDP); Dy CM Pawan Kalyan (JSP); NDA = TDP–JSP–BJP (since Jun 2024).

items.front: Which law made Amaravati AP's sole capital, and its assent date?
items.back: AP Reorganization (Amendment) Act, 2026; Presidential assent 6 Apr 2026 (amended Section 5(2) of the 2014 Act).
items.examPoint: Amaravati — permanent statutory sole-capital status (Reorganisation Amendment Act 2026)

items.front: Annadata Sukhibhava: total annual support and the Centre/State split?
items.back: ₹20,000/yr per farmer family = ₹6,000 central PM-KISAN + ₹14,000 State; replaces YSR Rythu Bharosa.
items.examPoint: Annadata Sukhibhava — ₹20,000/yr = ₹6,000 PM-KISAN + ₹14,000 State, replaces YSR Rythu Bharosa

items.front: Thalliki Vandanam — benefit, route, launch, and scheme it replaced?
items.back: ₹15,000/yr per school child, paid to the mother; launched Jun 2025; replaces Amma Vodi.
items.examPoint: Thalliki Vandanam — ₹15,000/yr per child, via mother, launched Jun 2025, replaces Amma Vodi

items.front: Match YSRCP scheme → renamed NDA scheme (4 pairs).
items.back: Amma Vodi→Thalliki Vandanam; YSR Rythu Bharosa→Annadata Sukhibhava; YSR Pension Kanuka→NTR Bharosa; Deepam→Deepam 2.0.
items.examPoint: Renamed schemes — Amma Vodi→Thalliki Vandanam; YSR Rythu Bharosa→Annadata Sukhibhava; YSR Pension Kanuka→NTR Bharosa Pensions; Deepam→Deepam 2.0

items.front: India's newest railway zone (2026) and its headquarters?
items.back: South Coast Railway (SCoR), operational 1 Jun 2026; HQ Visakhapatnam.

items.front: Alluri Sitarama Raju International Airport — location and commercial-shift date?
items.back: Bhogapuram (near Visakhapatnam); inaugurated 1 Aug 2026, commercial ops shifted 17 Aug 2026.
items.examPoint: Alluri Sitarama Raju International Airport, Bhogapuram

items.front: Amaravati Quantum Valley testbeds (14 Apr 2026) — what and why notable?
items.back: 1S (superconducting) & 1Q testbeds on World Quantum Day; AP is first state with a Quantum Test Reference Facility.
items.examPoint: Amaravati Quantum Valley — 1S/1Q Quantum Testbeds (14 Apr 2026)

items.front: INS Aridhaman (commissioned 3 Apr 2026 at Visakhapatnam) is India's 3rd what?
items.back: Nuclear-powered ballistic-missile submarine (SSBN), after Arihant and Arighaat.
items.examPoint: INS Aridhaman — 3rd nuclear-powered submarine commissioned at Visakhapatnam (3 Apr 2026)

items.front: AP Budget 2026-27 — who presented it, on what date, projected GSDP?
items.back: FM Payyavula Keshav, 14 Feb 2026; GSDP (current prices) ~₹19,75,073 cr (~12% growth).

items.front: P4 model and Swarna Andhra @2047 poverty targets?
items.back: P4 (Public-Private-People): Margadarsis (top 10%) aid Bangaru Kutumbalu (bottom 20%), zero poverty by 2029; Swarna Andhra targets 2047.
items.examPoint: P4 (Public-Private-People Partnership) — Margadarsis (top 10%) support Bangaru Kutumbalu (bottom 20%), zero poverty by 2029

items.front: APPSC Group-1 Notification 07/2026 — release date & vacancies?
items.back: Released 6 Oct 2026; 166 vacancies; Screening Test 24 Jan 2027.
items.examPoint: APPSC Group-1 Notification 07/2026 — key dates & vacancies

items.front: Which is India’s largest tiger reserve (in AP)?
items.back: Nagarjunasagar-Srisailam Tiger Reserve.
items.examPoint: AP protected areas — tiger reserve, biosphere & Ramsar sites

items.front: AP GSDP (2025-26) and farm-sector standing?
items.back: ≈₹17.62 trillion; “leading performer” in agriculture (~8.8%) — Economic Survey 2024-25.

items.front: Polavaram — Full Reservoir Level and spillway capacity?
items.back: FRL 150 ft above MSL; spillway about 36 lakh cusecs (Godavari).

items.back: Tobacco, mango, onion and coconut (plus drones/precision spraying).
